scripts.build: npm run build -w @peekjob/shared && npm run build -w @peekjob/web && npm run build -w @peekjob/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @peekjob/shared && npm run test -w @peekjob/api
scripts.build:e2e: npm run build -w @peekjob/shared && npm run build -w @peekjob/api && VITE_API_URL=/ VITE_ROUTER=browser npm run build -w @peekjob/web
scripts.e2e:coverage: rm -rf e2e/.nyc_output && E2E_COVERAGE=1 playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts; s=$?; nyc report --temp-dir ../../e2e/.nyc_output --cwd apps/web --report-dir coverage/e2e --reporter=lcov --reporter=text-summary --exclude-after-remap=false; exit $s
scripts.build:e2e:coverage: npm run build -w @peekjob/shared && npm run build -w @peekjob/api && VITE_COVERAGE=true VITE_API_URL=/ VITE_ROUTER=browser npm run build -w @peekjob/web
